newsitem.title: CHINA: China oil firm sees 1996 output of 11 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China oil firm sees 1996 output of 11 mln tonnes.

text.p: China's largest offshore oil producer China Offshore Oil Nan Hai East Corp (CONHE) expects to pump more than 11 million tonnes of oil in 1996, the official China Daily newspaper said on Wednesday.
Output topped 10 million tonnes as of November 11 and current levels of production were expected to be sustained over the next three years, the newspaper said.

CONHE, the major Chinese exploration firm in the South China Sea, is a subsidiary of the China National Offshore Oil Corp. The company now operates eight offshore fields, including Chin's largest, Liuhua 11, China Daily said.
It quoted company president Qian Fuhao as saying he expected more foreign firms to become involved through public bidding in exploration of the eastern areas of the South China Sea.
"CONHE has just discovered a deposit in the east district of the South China Sea which may yield more than five billion tonnes," it quoted Qian as saying without giving details.
Chinese offshore oil production, which includes other fields besides those in the South China Sea, accounts for around 10 percent of total national output.
